evidence_tier: news-blind and analyst-blind; baseline-informed (the outcome sat inside Stage 1's rolling-origin training); single contest - a case study, whatever the result
combination_rule: each window is served by the arm with the largest committed 2026 news-vs-recalibrated delta in that window; ties at 4 dp fall to alphabetical arm order
specifications: each arm uses its frozen two-column feature set from the estimability audit; ridge penalty and all fitting, prediction, contest-normalisation and seat-allocation code are the frozen modules already in the repository
baseline_rows: the Stage 1 out-of-fold rows for surrey-county-council-by-election-woking-south-2025-07-10 (split rolling_2025-07-10, 5 candidates), outcome columns stripped at load by strip_outcome_columns

collection.method: the by-election collection pipeline unchanged: registry sources, the standard query template, CDX and dated-search routes
collection.funnel: frozen eligibility rules; LLM E4/E8 batch with the production models; human E5 for local rows; frozen extraction, model assignment unchanged

stop_loss.rule: if the assembled corpus holds fewer than MIN_USABLE_ARTICLES usable articles, the test aborts and the shortfall is recorded as the finding

endpoints.primary: contest MAE of the window-weighted combination against the untouched baseline
endpoints.reference: contest MAE of each single arm
endpoints.secondary: winner call; per-party signed errors, Reform UK reported explicitly
endpoints.reading_rules: one contest, five candidates: illustrative evidence only; no arm or combination may be promoted from this result; every specification's number is reported, none selected

unseal.only_reader: src/news_modelling/woking_south_unseal.py (to be written; the ONLY code permitted to read observed columns for this election)
unseal.preconditions: a predictions file exists under news_features/woking_south_blind_v1/ AND its exact bytes are reachable in git history (verified with git cat-file); otherwise the unseal refuses to run
unseal.prohibition: until the unseal runs, no code or person in this analysis reads observed_vote_share, observed_rank, observed_elected, error or any outcome column for surrey-county-council-by-election-woking-south-2025-07-10 from any file
